definition.frequency: Distinct sale invoices. Fixed bins (ties make quantiles unstable): 1, 2, 3-4, 5-8, 9+ invoices score 1 to 5.
definition.monetary: Net GBP: sale lines minus credit-note lines. Score 5 = top quintile.
definition.recency: Days from the customer's last sale invoice to the snapshot date (2011-12-10). Score 5 = most recent quintile.
definition.scoring: Recency and monetary use quintile edges of the 5,852 customers; frequency uses fixed bins. Segments are the first matching rule in the listed order.
definition.ties: Quintile edges are cut with numpy.quantile at 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8; a value equal to an edge falls in the higher bin.

grid.axes: Row index = first axis score 1 to 5, column index = second axis score 1 to 5. Recency score 5 = most recent.

segments.action_note: Frequent and not lapsed; spend below champions or slightly less recent.
Used to buy often, quiet for a long time.
